changes: New sign-in and setup look: dark navy and neon
Home: the channel cards are gone; the Live streams row and Share J Player stay
Series row on Home, with K-Drama, C-Drama and other language rows under it
Copies pill moved into the bottom row; tap the quality badge to switch to the next copy
Subtitle and audio panels: tracks first, the video's own subtitle at the top
Drag on the subtitle text to move it, pinch on it to resize it
Open link on Home: paste a stream link and it plays
A stream can be removed from the Live row, and a deleted post leaves the row too
Settings search, your own hidden words for titles, and chosen chats marked in the Chats list
Background play: the notification and reopening the app return to the playing video
The Back to and Start over offers leave on any seek, and stay at most five seconds
